name: Skewering Hall
disable: DC 47 Thievery check (master) to disable the pressure plate

items.name: Skewer
items.text:
Trigger Pressure is applied to the pressure plate

text: A dozen spears hidden within sockets in the walls thrust into the hall when the pressure plate is triggered.
